en.title: Basel Framework: MAR33.15 IMCC(C_i)
en.summary: IMCC(C_i) in MAR33.15 contains the ratio ES_F,C,i / ES_R,C,i, which has no value for a risk class without positions. The CRR writes the convention out (Article 325bb(3) includes a risk class only where the portfolio has a modellable risk factor in it); the Basel text does not.
en.impact: Position: Bank with IMA desks in rates, equity, FX, credit only; no commodity positions. Commodity class: ES_R,S,i = 0, ES_F,C,i = 0, ES_R,C,i = 0. Reading a: IMCC(C_commodity) = 0 x 0/0 undefined, IMCC cannot be computed Reading b: class skipped / contributes 0, IMCC = rho*IMCC(C) + (1-rho)*sum over 4 classes Difference: undefined vs defined capital number; also applies when ES_R,C,i is 0 while ES_F,C,i > 0 (factors not in reduced set): ratio infinite
en.correction: Clarify or correct the cited passage so that the rule and its references give one result for the stated case.

quotes.text: ES_{R,S} is then scaled up by the ratio of (i) the current ES using the full set of risk factors to (ii) the current ES measure using the reduced set of factors.
